plainTranslation: Friction and pull at once. You want each other and rub each other wrong. Hot, hard to ignore. Aim the charge at passion, not fights. Notice if the spark needs conflict to stay lit.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
